countryAndBiographyScope: Country codes are game catalog labels. Raw team registry establishes participation for named teams and dates only. Retrieved profile title establishes playing nation association for ambiguous/abbreviated cases. Birth year/DOB and nationality eligibility were not independently audited. Identity evidence confers no numeric skill confidence.
duplicateEvidencePolicy: Key every observed delivery by source match and delivery location, and every player by Cricsheet identifier. Alias labels must never create additional observations. Current catalog has 412 distinct canonical IDs; Mike/Michael Hussey is one catalog identity, not duplicate active pool IDs.
registerLicense: Open Data Commons Attribution License; credit Cricsheet (https://cricsheet.org/) and retain source/licensing references.
limitations: Profile verification uses primary-source search retrieval; direct www.espncricinfo.com fetch returned HTTP 403, but www.cricinfo.com indexed primary profile title and URL were retrieved.
Exact official aliases were searched across all register names; aliases are not presumed globally unique.
Country/team participation is supporting identity context, not DOB certification.
No production data or saved-game IDs were modified by this audit.
